Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of fostering entrepreneurship in Belgium.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build/maintain WordPress sites, which has honed my project management and content creation skills. I am also an AI enthusiast, using tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate tasks and improve efficiency. My experience with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs) and social media integration aligns well with your need for data-driven communication strategies.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines strategic communication with operational efficiency, and I am eager to leverage AI to streamline workflows and amplify your programs' impact. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am comfortable working in English (Dutch B1, improving).

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can benefit Pulse Foundation. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position at Pulse Foundation. As a digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and AI-powered workflows, I am drawn to your mission of fostering entrepreneurship and creating lasting impact. The hybrid nature of this role—combining storytelling with operational efficiency—perfectly aligns with my skills and interests.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build/maintain client websites on WordPress. This has given me hands-on experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously, from content creation to technical implementation. I am also an AI enthusiast, regularly using tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate repetitive tasks, draft content, and streamline workflows. I have applied these skills to my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines.

Your need for an 'efficiency enthusiast' resonates with me. I am passionate about identifying low-value tasks and implementing tech solutions to eliminate them, freeing up time for strategic work. I am proficient in Canva, Mailchimp, and analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, and I am eager to learn and integrate automation tools like Zapier/Make into your communication processes.

I am highly organized, autonomous, and comfortable in fast-paced environments. My experience in logistics has taught me the importance of accuracy and efficiency, which I bring to all my work. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available to work in Brussels as required.

I would love the opportunity to contribute to Pulse Foundation's impactful programs and help shape internal processes that endure. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
